remarks: Welcome to Old Greenwich! A great opportunity to own a 1-bedroom plus den, 2 full bath garden-level condo in the sought-after Old Greenwich Gables. This inviting home features a newly updated kitchen with white cabinetry and granite countertops, along with an open layout that offers comfortable everyday living. The unit has been freshly painted, and the hardwood floors have been refinished, creating a clean, move-in ready feel. Sliders lead to a private patio overlooking the beautifully landscaped courtyard. The spacious primary suite includes a luxurious bath, while the versatile den is ideal for a home office, guest room, or additional living space. Additional highlights include garage parking, central air, in-unit washer and dryer, and storage. Enjoy access to community amenities such as a pool, gym, squash court, and clubhouse. Conveniently located near the Old Greenwich train, shops, restaurants, Binney Park, Tod's Point, and the new Civic Center.  An exceptional opportunity to enjoy the Old Greenwich lifestyle.  --
